clauses.text: 11.4 When assessing the percentage area that will be renovated of an individual thermal element, consider whether the element is being renovated from the outside or the inside, following Diagram 11.1 and Diagram 11.2, respectively. Building Regulations 2010 R6, R22, R23(1), L1(a) For example, if external render is being removed from the outer side of a wall, the area of the thermal element is the area of the elevation in which that wall sits. Overheating Mitigation: O1.—(1) Reasonable provision must be made to—(a) limit unwanted solar gains in summer;(b) provide an adequate means to remove heat from the indoor environment.(2) In meeting the obligations in sub-paragraph (1)—(a) account must be taken of the safety of any occupant, and their reasonable enjoyment of the building; and(b) mechanical cooling may only be used where insufficient heat is capable of being removed from the indoor environment without it. | Requirement O1 applies only to the erection of the following buildings—(a) a dwelling;(b) an institution; or(c) any other building containing one or more rooms for residential purposes (other than a room in a hotel).

route.instructions: Under the Building Regulations 2010 in England, which notification route applies to this work item if it is carried out on its own in the building described?

criteria.not_notifiable: No Building Regulations notice needed: not building work (reg 3), only Schedule 4 work, or an exempt building (reg 9, Schedule 2).
criteria.competent_person_scheme: Notifiable work listed in Schedule 3: a registered competent person can self-certify it (reg 12(6)(a)); otherwise a building notice is needed.
criteria.building_notice_or_full_plans: Building work not covered by Schedules 3 or 4: a building notice or a full plans application to building control (reg 12(2)).
criteria.full_plans_required: Building work that must have a full plans application: the Fire Safety Order applies to the building (reg 12(3)), it fronts a private street (12(4)), or H4 applies (building over or near a sewer, 12(5)).
